2015.rateExcludedReason: Its main campus's Clery geography includes a hospital: its report says "The AdventHealth University main campus is comprised of one University Campus and Hospital" and that the hospital "is patrolled by the Florida Hospital Security Department". DOE's figures do not separate the hospital's incidents, and its patients, visitors and staff are not in the university's FTE. IPEDS does not flag it (HOSPITAL 2, Carnegie basic 26, Special Focus: Other Health Professions, in every year). So a rate per student would not measure its campus population. It has no rate; its counts are shown. Source: AdventHealth University Annual Security Report, Orlando, 2018, https://my.adu.edu/sites/default/files/ASRorlando2018.pdf
